	salary float32

package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	ch1 := make(chan int)
	ch2 := make(chan int)
	ch3 := make(chan int)
	var s1, s2, s3 int
	fmt.Scanln(&s1)
	fmt.Scanln(&s2)
	fmt.Scanln(&s3)
	go download(s1, ch1)
	go download(s2, ch2)
	go download(s3, ch3)

	fmt.Println(<-ch1 + <-ch2 + <-ch3)
}
func download(d int, c chan int) {
	var sum int
	for i := 0; i <= d; i++ {
		sum += i
	}
	c <- sum
}
